note: Superior NF (Tofte district) rustic campground in a stand of red pine above Baker Lake, at a Boundary Waters entry point: the lake is non-motorized and most of it lies inside the BWCAW, which needs a permit. Pull-in sites not designed for RVs - 2 of the 5 have spurs over 21 ft that may fit a small RV; the access road dead-ends with no turnaround, so assess before driving a larger rig in. No garbage pickup; pack out trash. --Claude
summary: FS page read: free, 5 sites (4 on the hilltop, 1 apart on FR 1272A), vault toilet, solar faucet water, season May 8-Oct 1 (new), max 9 people a site, first-come (not on recreation.gov). Lakefront could not be earned: proposed not waterfront. Phone added (Tofte RD). Pin sits in the lake inlet; move to the FS point.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (lakefront -> not waterfront): the FS says the four main sites are 'at the top of the hill' and the fifth is 'away from the lake'. On imagery the FS point 47.84447,-90.81707 is a small clearing in continuous red-pine canopy about 70 m from the lake's south narrows and about 85 m from the open landing on the main basin (47.8456,-90.8170); the only open ground at the shore is that landing/BWCAW access, which is day use. No site map, site numbers or campsite photos exist on the FS page, so no site can be placed on open ground near the water and no view from a site is shown. Under the unsure rule it goes down to not waterfront (no view evidence for lakeview).

PIN in the water: stored 47.8443,-90.8151 sits on the lake's south inlet/marsh, ~150 m east of the FS point 47.84447,-90.81707, which falls on a clearing among the hilltop sites. Under 250 m, but a pin in a lake channel is wrong: suggest 47.8445,-90.8171.
Phone: none -> 218-663-8060 (Tofte Ranger District, named on the campground page).

CRITERIA (rig length, caveat already in the note): the FS singles this campground out - 'Sites are pull-in and not specifically designed for RVs. Two of the five sites have spurs over 21 feet long and may accommodate an RV. The road into the camping area dead ends without a turn around'. No stated length of 23 ft+, and no recent review with a 23 ft+ rig was searched for or found. Unclear fit: keep with the caveat (AWH 2026-11-02).

Status: the page shows 'Site Partially Closed / Closed-No fees or services' under Current Conditions, read in November after the published Oct 1 season end; read as the off-season state, not a closure. Roads are not plowed in winter.
